"title": "Request estate document package",
"text": "Subject: Estate planning document request\n\nHello Nolan Wrenpuddle,\n\nTo help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:\n\n- Will\n- Revocable trust or other trust agreements\n- Trust amendments or restatements\n- Durable power of attorney\n- Health care directive or medical power of attorney\n- Beneficiary designation confirmations\n- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details\n- Any recent attorney summary letter\n\nIf another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: [________________].\n\nPreferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]\nDocuments already on file: [________________]\nDocuments still needed: [________________]\n\nThank you,\nApricot Compass Advisory\n\nObtain the current estate document package for Nolan Wrenpuddle to ensure the file includes the latest trust, will, and related documents.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-02-19",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Address IRA beneficiary inconsistency",
"text": "Review the Roth IRA beneficiary designation, which currently lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary, and align it with the traditional IRA where Lena and Oscar are equal beneficiaries, per Nolan Wrenpuddle's expectation.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-02-26",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Verify successor trustee sequence",
"text": "Confirm the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence, ensuring that Priya Nettlewhisk’s acceptance is documented and evaluating whether an additional child trustee should be added, as requested by Nolan Wrenpuddle.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-03-05",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Further follow-up is also needed by 2026-03-05 on the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence, because Carla remains ahead of Priya and Nolan is unsure whether Priya signed any acceptance or whether another child should be added later; this affects the estate review and possible future trust account administration steps."
}
]
